name: Propiomazine
summary: Propiomazine, sold under the brand name Propavan among others, is an antihistamine which is used to treat insomnia and to produce sedation and relieve anxiety before or during surgery or other procedures and in combination with analgesics as well as during labor. Propiomazine is a phenothiazine, but is not used therapeutically as a neuroleptic because it does not block dopamine receptors well.

pharmacology.text: Propiomazine is an antagonist of the dopamine D1, D2, and D4 receptors, the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors, the muscarinic acetylcholine receptors M1, M2, M3, M4, and M5 receptors, α1-adrenergic receptor, and histamine H1 receptor.

uses.text: Propiomazine has been used in the treatment of insomnia.

sideEffects.text: Drowsiness is a usual side effect. Rare, serious side effects include convulsions (seizures); difficult or unusually fast breathing; fast or irregular heartbeat or pulse; fever (high); high or low blood pressure; loss of bladder control; muscle stiffness (severe); unusual increase in sweating; unusually pale skin; and unusual tiredness or weakness.

fact.en: Although propiomazine belongs to the same phenothiazine family as chlorpromazine, it is used mainly as a sleep aid and sedative rather than as an antipsychotic.
fact.zh: Propiomazine 雖然和氯普麻同屬啡噻嗪類，主要卻是作為助眠和鎮靜藥使用，而非抗精神病藥。
